Features.Name: Sneak Attack
Features.Description: Once per turn, deal an extra 3d6 damage to one creature you hit with a finesse or ranged weapon if you have advantage.

Features.Name: Cunning Action
Features.Description: Take a bonus action each turn in combat to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

Features.Name: Darkvision
Features.Description: See in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light.

Features.Name: Fey Ancestry
Features.Description: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can’t put you to sleep.

Traits: I always keep my cool, even in dire situations.
I have a sarcastic sense of humor.
Ideals: Freedom: Chains are meant to be broken, as are those who would forge them.
Bonds: My crew is my family, and I’d do anything to protect them.
Flaws: I can’t resist a shiny gem or coin, even when it gets me into trouble.

Backstory: Arannis grew up in the underbelly of a bustling city, surviving on quick wits and quicker hands. Over the years, he became a skilled thief and scout, but his sense of loyalty to his companions keeps him from becoming just another cutthroat criminal.
Notes: Prefers ambushes and hit-and-run tactics. Keeps a personal journal written in thieves' cant.
